title: Profiles
description: Your public presence on Kahana: photo, bio, links, public hubs, reputation signals (views, saves, Aura, followers, purchases), Following and Saved.
content:
Your profile is one link for your presence. hubs you’ve shared and the reputation you grow. It is not a social feed and not a vanity score.

Primary action: Open your profile in the app → copy /profile/:userId.

What’s on a profile

  • Photo and name. Avatar and optional background so people recognize you.
  • Bio and tagline. A short story of what you share and who it is for.
  • Links. Social and custom links, easy to share like a link-in-bio.
  • Public hubs. The hubs you have made public, with view and monetization cues where relevant.

How reputation shows up

  • Views. How often people open what you share.
  • Saves. When someone keeps a hub for later.
  • Aura. Careful endorsements on hubs worth learning from.
  • Followers. People who want to keep up with your public work.
  • Purchases. When someone pays for access to a monetized hub.

Product facts

  • Your public page lives at /profile/:userId. Guests can open it.
  • Edit through profile settings (/profile/:userId/settings and related settings).
  • A profile pic is part of the Library-listing checklist for hubs. Missing one can block listing readiness.
  • Buyers also find creators via Following (/following) and saved hubs (/saved).

Verified creators

A verified badge can appear when Stripe Connect is charge-ready (charges_enabled). It helps buyers trust who you are. It does not boost Library ranking. See Trust and Your profile & sharing.

Setup how-to

Step-by-step edit, share, and badge details: Your profile & sharing.

What’s next

  • List a hub on Library.
  • Get started (creators).
  • Analytics for creators.
  • Browse Library.

Open the app → your profile
